title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 4000KW Series Very Low Noise | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 4000 KW Series Hub low-noise fan assemblies. Cooling Tower replacement parts from ICST.

layout.title: Hudson Tuf-Lite III 4000KW Series Very Low Noise | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 11′ Through 20′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 4 to 12.

Tuf-Lite III fan blades are constructed of light weight, corrosion resistant, fiberglass reinforced vinyl-ester resin, with materials, thickness, and processes determined from finite element analysis modeling. Tuf-Edge leading-edge erosion and UV protection come standard with this blade.
